story.titleZh: F1马德里赛道练习首日：赢家与输家初现
story.summaryZh: F1在马德里赛道（马德里赛道）的首日正式赛道练习并未出现预期中的混乱，但已初步显现出一些赢家与输家。
story.originalTitle: Winners and losers from F1 Madring practice
story.summaryEn: The first official day of F1 track running at the Madring in Madrid did not produce the chaos that had been predicted, and first impressions up and down the field seem seriously positive.
detailZh: 在马德里赛道上进行的第一个正式一级方程式赛道行驶日，并没有出现预期中的混乱。
但它确实带来了早期的赢家和输家……
在一处新场地进行一级方程式赛道行驶的第一天总是令人紧张，尤其是一条被预测会立刻变成混乱大熔炉的赛道。
在三级方程式和二级方程式中，这在很大程度上确实如此——但一级方程式的车手们总体上保持了秩序，而且从场上的初步印象来看，各方的反馈都相当积极。
不过必须先说明一点：一如既往，大家都有充分理由去高度赞扬这场新比赛，而周日正赛的比赛质量仍存在很大的疑问——不过意外偏高的轮胎磨损或许会有所帮助。
但这条赛道正在获得早期的认可。
"我们见过不少街道赛道在一级方程式中来来去去——而现在就已经能感觉到，这条赛道是会留下来的，"梅赛德斯车队副领队布拉德利·洛德欣喜地说道。
"我认为，要在明天的排位赛中做出一个完美单圈将会是真正的挑战，而这正是它本该有的样子。"
小红牛领队阿兰·佩尔马内说：“我认为这是一座非常非常令人印象深刻的设施。它给人的感觉不像是他们随便在某个停车场里铺出来的一条新街道赛道，而真的能感觉到他们花了时间和心思，打造出了一条非常有趣的赛道。真的令人印象深刻。”
车手们的看法不一定完全一致（比如维斯塔潘承认他原则上就不喜欢街道赛道），但在这方面也有相当多的赞扬，加斯利表示他“非常喜欢”这条赛道，勒克莱尔则欣赏这条需要“投入承诺”的赛道，其抓地力比预期更高。——瓦伦丁·霍罗恩日伊
当然，并不是每个人都保持了干净——林德布拉德是个例外，他引发了一次长长的滑移，最终右后轮先撞上了13号弯的护栏。
“看起来挺严重的，但其实撞击并不算很重，”他事后说道。“勒克莱尔在蒙扎那次撞得可壮观多了！”
"是的，有一些损坏，数量不小，相当多，但没有什么是修不好的。所以我只能向工程师们道歉，尤其是机械师们，因为很遗憾他们今晚要多干一些活了。"——维克（VK）
即使发生了撞车，林德布拉德和他的老板佩尔马内仍然非常明显地、颇有深意地保持乐观——他们相信他与前方仅0.228秒的差距是一个真实的信号。
"这其实算不上百感交集，我宁愿开着一辆受损的车排在第4位，也不愿开着一辆四个轮子都好好的车排在第18位。"佩尔马内兴奋地说。
"这当然不理想，我们肯定不能每个周末都这样——但我们可以接受这一点。
“毫无疑问这辆车很快，非常快，今天确实是第四名的节奏。我不说明天下午还能有第四名的节奏，但我认为它会非常接近前排。”
林德布拉德说：“我们凭实力拿到第四。我们在第二节自由练习里跑出的每一圈都很快，这才是最重要的。” —— VK
在新的F1赛道上的黄金法则：在练习中尽可能多跑圈数，确保自己做好准备。
遗憾的是，迈凯伦没能遵守这条法则，因为变速箱故障导致兰多·诺里斯在第二节自由练习中没能进行任何有意义的行驶。这本是让赛车和车手进入最佳状态窗口的大好机会。
如果这还不够糟糕的话，确实参加了两节练习赛的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里表示，车队目前"缺乏速度"。
我们之前见过迈凯伦在艰难的周五之后实现逆转，但通常表现强劲的梅赛德斯以及看起来正在复苏的法拉利，无疑让接下来的这场比赛显得格外艰难。——杰克·贝尼翁
哈斯在蒙扎于两台赛车上首次启用的升级套件，一直被预期在马德里赛道上会有更好的表现，而早期的赛道证据也支持了这一点。
埃斯特班·奥康在第二节自由练习中排名第九，练习结束后他称这是一个"非常棒的日子"，初步迹象表明他不再受到在蒙扎限制他发挥的赛车不稳定问题的困扰。
奥康说：“看来不像我们在蒙扎时那样不稳定。”
“我们又对赛车更换了许多部件，现在看来运转得相当不错。”
“今晚我们需要深入研究一下，看看究竟是什么地方改进了，但到目前为止，从驾驶感受来说，我觉得今天并没有出现问题。”
“显然，我们需要在明天继续保持这种状态。总体来说，情况相当不错。”
他还指出，这条赛道上轮胎颗粒化现象普遍，这对哈斯是个好消息，因为哈斯受颗粒化影响比对手要小。——乔什·萨蒂尔
红牛车队这一天最有趣的一幕是，当维斯塔潘被问到，考虑到林德布拉德（第二次自由练习赛排名第四）的位置，他是否想要更多时，他的回答非常搞笑：“我不开那辆车，所以我不知道它有多快。”
维斯塔潘只是指出需要改进赛车平衡，而队友利亚姆·劳森则抱怨后轮抓地力不足。不过，这一天还是挺复杂的，因为尽管维斯塔潘在第一次自由练习赛中的排名更高，位列第四，但在第二次自由练习赛中排名第六时，他反而更接近梅赛德斯的节奏。
可以说，我们目前还无法清楚地判断红牛、迈凯伦和法拉利之间的格局，但法拉利现在显然占据上风，而红牛可能再一次只是F1第四快的车队。——JB
这样一条艰难的赛道仍然有可能让2026年的标杆车队栽跟头，但目前梅赛德斯看起来相当从容地占据领先，拉塞尔和安东内利各自在一节练习中排名最快。
“我们在第一节自由练习开局不错，赛车从一开始就很强，”第一节自由练习速度最快的拉塞尔说。
“我们为第二节自由练习做了一些调校改动，但我不确定这些改动是否让赛车变好了，所以我们可能会在一夜之间把其中一些改回来。”
从有限的长距离测试数据来看，没有任何迹象表明梅赛德斯不会作为微弱的热门车队再次进入本周末剩余的比赛。 - JS
detailEn: The first day of proper Formula 1 on-track running at the Madring didn't produce the predicted chaos.
But it did provide some early winners and losers...
A first day of F1 track action at a venue is always scary times, especially for a track that was tipped to be an immediate cauldron of chaos.
This was largely true in Formula 3 and Formula 2 - but the Formula 1 grid by and large kept things tidy, and first impressions up and down the field seem seriously positive.

This has to be caveated with the note that, as always, it's in everyone's best interest to speak highly of the new race, and there are serious question marks over the quality of race action on Sunday - though unexpectedly high tyre wear might help.
But the track is getting early approval.
"We've seen street circuits come and go in Formula 1 - and it feels already like this is one that's here to stay," rejoiced Mercedes deputy team boss Bradley Lord.
"I think putting the perfect lap together tomorrow in qualifying is going to be a real challenge and that's exactly what it should be."

"I think it's a very, very impressive facility," said Racing Bulls chief Alan Permane. "It doesn't feel like a new street track they've just sort of slapped down in a car park, it really feels like they've taken some time and effort and put together a really interesting circuit. Really impressed."

Drivers weren't necessarily unanimous (Max Verstappen, for instance, just doesn't care for street circuits in principle, as he admitted), but there was significant praise on that end, too, with Pierre Gasly saying he "really loved it" and Charles Leclerc appreciating a "commitment" track with higher grip than expected. - Valentin Khorounzhiy
OK, not everybody kept it clean - with Lindblad the outlier, triggering a long slide that ended with a right-rear-first smack into the Turn 13 barriers.
"It looked quite bad, but actually the impact was not very hard," he said afterwards. "Charles did it in much more spectacular fashion in Monza!

"Yeah, there's a bit of damage, it's a good amount, quite a lot, but nothing that's not repairable. So I just apologise to the engineers, but especially the mechanics, because they've got a bit of extra work tonight, unfortunately." - VK
Even with the crash, both Lindblad and his boss Permane were remarkably, tellingly bullish - believing his mere 0.228s deficit to the front was a genuine signal.
"It's not really mixed emotions, I'd much rather be in 4th place with a damaged car than 18th place with a car with four wheels on," enthused Permane.
"It's not ideal of course, and we certainly can't do that every weekend - but we can accept that.
"There's no doubt the car is quick, very quick, it's properly P4 pace today, and I don't say it'll be P4 pace tomorrow afternoon, but it'll be right up there, I think."
Lindblad said: "We were P4 on merit. Every lap we did in FP2 we were fast, so that's the most important thing." - VK
Golden rule at a new F1 track: get as many laps in during practice to make sure you're prepared.
Sadly, McLaren couldn't follow that rule as a gearbox failure ruled Lando Norris out of any meaningful running in FP2. A big opportunity to get the car and driver in the right window.
If that wasn't bad enough, Oscar Piastri, who did get the two practices in, said that the team is "lacking pace".

We've seen McLaren turn things around from difficult Fridays before, but the usual Mercedes juggernaut and what looks like a resurgent Ferrari certainly make this look like a tough event ahead. - Jack Benyon
The upgrade Haas debuted on both cars at Monza was always expected to work better at the Madring and the early on-track evidence supports that.
Esteban Ocon was ninth in FP2, calling it a “very good day” after practice, with early indications suggesting he doesn’t have the car inconsistency issues that limited him at Monza.
“There doesn't seem to be the inconsistency that we had in Monza,” Ocon said.
“We've changed many parts on the car again, and now it seems to be working quite well.
“We need to have a deep dive tonight to see what has improved exactly, but so far, driving the car, I'm not feeling that today there was an issue.
“We need to obviously keep that going for tomorrow. Overall, it's been pretty good.”
He also suggested the prevalence of tyre graining at this circuit is good news for Haas, which suffers less from it than its rivals do. - Josh Suttill

The best part of Red Bull's day was Verstappen's retort when asked if he would have wanted more given where Lindblad (fourth in FP2) was, and Max's hilarious reply was "I don't drive that car, so I don't know how fast it is".

Verstappen merely pointed to needing to improve the balance, while team-mate Liam Lawson complained of a lack of rear grip. Still, it was a complicated day, as even though Verstappen finished higher up the order in FP1, in fourth, he was closer to the Mercedes' pace in FP2 when he was sixth.

It's fair to say we haven't got a clear picture of where the Red Bull/McLaren/Ferrari picture lies, but Ferrari certainly seems to have the upper hand at the moment, and Red Bull might be F1's fourth-best team, again. - JB

Such a tough track still has the potential to catch 2026’s benchmark team out, but for now Mercedes looks reasonably comfortable out front with George Russell and Kimi Antonelli topping a practice session each.
“We started well in FP1, and the car was strong from the off,” FP1 pacesetter Russell said.
“We made some set-up changes for FP2, but I’m not sure they improved the car, so we may row back on them overnight.”
From the limited long-run data, there’s nothing to suggest Mercedes doesn’t head into the rest of the weekend as the marginal favourites once again. - JS
keyPointsZh: 此前外界预计马德里赛道会立刻成为混乱的漩涡，但F1车手们基本保持了秩序。
混乱场面主要出现在F3和F2的比赛中。
从场上各队的第一印象来看，评价普遍非常积极。
keyPointsEn: Chaos largely materialised in Formula 3 and Formula 2, but the Formula 1 grid by and large kept things tidy.
The track had been tipped to be an immediate cauldron of chaos.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
